tasks.title: Validate subscription settings and persist securely deletable subscriber state
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, R3 settings/store/cleanup and R9 validation, R10 stored inventory/retention and R5 subscribers delete implementation (dispatch comes in T4); D7/D14/D18/D19, store/cleanup/settings/operator-deletion checks and corresponding counterexamples. Pin the merged contract full SHA here. Supply independent injectable settings, store and CLI components, including SMTP login validation and cleanup's deleted-row cancellation seam; actual queue cancellation is completed/tested with worker 1 in T2 and production wiring in T4.

acceptance.expected: 0 failing tests; focused coverage may fail its threshold, so no focused exit-0 requirement. R3 settings default to off and ignore subscription settings then; on requires named variables, bounds MAX/MAX_PENDING with pending <= total, SMTP and secret rules. MAX=5 with MAX_PENDING unset (default 1000), or MAX_PENDING=6, exits 2 naming PULSE_NOTIFY_SUBSCRIPTIONS_MAX_PENDING; MAX=5 with MAX_PENDING=5 is accepted. Keys of 63 or 65 hex characters, or uppercase keys, fail without echoing values. R9 accepts an origin with/without slash and refuses /pulse and /pulse/ with the exact fixed line before secret/store/lock/listener I/O. Store uses version 1, WAL/FULL/secure_delete, mode 0600 and its own lease lock; refuses other versions; every mutation is transactional; persists passes and next_pass_at without changing the channel ledger.

0 failing tests; SMTP_PASSWORD_FILE without SMTP_USERNAME and SMTP_USERNAME without the file each give startup exit 2 naming PULSE_NOTIFY_SUBSCRIPTIONS_SMTP_PASSWORD_FILE. A username with SMTP_TLS=none and host mailpit gives exit 2 naming PULSE_NOTIFY_SUBSCRIPTIONS_SMTP_TLS; loopback 127.0.0.1 is accepted. A password file containing the literal s3cret-pw followed by one newline yields password 's3cret-pw'; empty or two-line files fail with exit 2 and no password/content in the error. Reuse readSecretFile and existing channel login rules. Focused coverage exit status is not the gate.

0 failing tests; independent clock/timer and second SQLite connection verify Cleanup boundaries: expiry 86400001 after last mail at t=1; t=86400000 keeps row, t=90000000 removes it even if every API poll fails; confirmed row remains at 10 * 86400000. Startup cleanup precedes requests. Prune settled/seeded events only after the retention period and only if absent from last good listedIds; prune nothing before first good read and never prune pending events. Deletion cascades deliveries, deleted address bytes are absent from the live database, WAL size is 0 after checkpoint; busy checkpoints warn without addresses and retry on cleanup; shutdown checkpoints.

0 failing tests for the independently callable CLI: normalize Sub-A@Example.com, delete pending/confirmed rows and deliveries under the store lock, output exactly 'deleted 1' then 'deleted 0', exit 0, and never output the address; missing store returns 'deleted 0' without creating it; held lock exits 2 unchanged; invalid address exits 1 with the fixed invalid-address line; missing/extra args exit 1 with 'usage: pulse-notify subscribers delete <address>'. CLI reads only state-path and lock settings and works with subscriptions off. Executable dispatch is completed/tested in T4.

exit 0; lint, typecheck, all tests and 80% full-suite line coverage pass with the new components independently testable. Existing main behavior/ledger suites remain green. README/configuration/operation document the new settings, exact R9 root-hosting sentence, data inventory, retention and stopped-service deletion. AGENTS names new components and corrects current ledger format 3 to 4 (preserve format 5 if #570 has merged); no ledger/config-file format changes.

tasks.title: Accept membership-free requests and cancel confirmation jobs immediately on deletion
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, R4 listener and complete R5 Subscribe/Confirm/Unsubscribe/Confirmation mail (worker 1 only), D8-D12/D19, R7 subscription request/limit/confirmation metrics, R8 notify limits L1-L7, R9 configured-origin links and R10 memory inventory/retention and confirmation text. All Notify listener, Lifecycle and timing, Confirmation queue (D19) and notify No enumeration counterexamples/checks; integrate T1 cleanup with synchronous cancellation here. Keep admission, row deletion/digest rotation, bounded FIFO, expiry, tokens and listener answers together; worker 2 is T3. Acceptance evidence items 6, 8 and 9 (password forwarded to fake sendMail).

acceptance.expected: 0 failing tests; focused coverage exit status is not the gate. Real 127.0.0.1:0 listener responses validate with the contract: path 404 -> method 405/allow POST -> auth 401 without reading even a 2 MiB body -> content-type 415 -> size >1024 gives 413 -> JSON/strict normalized shape 400 -> operation. Wrong bearer plus one character fails; no token/address is echoed. headersTimeout/requestTimeout are 10000 ms; JSON/no-store/x-pulse-contract:1 headers are invariant; closed-store requests give literal 503 unavailable.

0 failing tests. Every notify No enumeration table case, fresh real store and HTTP fixture, both K/U orders: below limits and L1/L2/L3/L4/L5/L6 return byte-equal 202 {"status":"accepted"}, headers except date identical; closed store returns the same 503 for both. Assert independent literal row/mail counts from Must also hold, L1 fixture MAX=2/MAX_PENDING=2 and L2 fixture MAX=10/MAX_PENDING=1, known id/consent unchanged, L1/L2/L5/L6 fixed limit labels, full 100-job queue, and 1024-byte size enforcement before address lookup. No 429 membership leak. Subscribe commits its write/queue decision before answering and never waits for SMTP or incident fan-out. L1 adds exactly 1 to limited_total{limit="capacity"} per unknown-address request; both request orders keep the known row unchanged.

0 failing tests. Injected times 0/599999/600000/1200000/1800000 give confirmation counts 1/1/2/3/3; rotation invalidates older token. Expiry boundary is 86399999 accepted versus 86400000 rejected from last mail. Repeat confirmation keeps first confirmed_at; unsubscribe twice is 200/200, wrong HMAC 404 preserves row, pending unsubscribe invalidates confirmation, and old id token cannot delete a resubscription. Sliding window=2 at 3599999 refuses work with invariant 202 and at 3600000 queues. Tokens are random 43 chars, stored hashed, unsubscribe is 22.43 HMAC with timingSafeEqual.

0 failing tests for FIFO worker 1: at most 100 queued/in-flight jobs, one send at a time, up to 3 attempts with existing retryDelay. Jobs hold only R5 fields; before EVERY attempt drop expired (now >= expiresAt), missing-row or changed-digest jobs. One recipient in To/envelope, exact R5 confirmation text includes 24 hours, deletion within 25 hours, configured-origin confirm/unsubscribe/notice links with one slash, stable Message-ID. Subscriber SMTP attempts receive min(PULSE_NOTIFY_TIMEOUT_MS, 60000), and configured password 's3cret-pw' reaches the fake sender. Queued gauge stays 1 until final success/failure counted and becomes 0 afterwards, success counter +1 before gauge zero; cancelled/dropped jobs increment neither mail counter. Shutdown aborts work and logs only dropped count, window/jobs reset on restart.

0 failing tests for EVERY Confirmation queue (D19), behind a blocked send counterexample, with injected clock/sleep/cleanup timer and literal expected values. A subscribes t=0, B t=1, C t=2; hold A attempt 1 unresolved, gauge 3, then independently: unsubscribe B t=10 answers 200 and gauge is 2 immediately, fake still called exactly 1 time (A); resolve A and only C sends, success 2. Cleanup t=90000000 deletes all three rows, gauge becomes 1 while A is still unresolved and fake calls stay 1; resolve A, gauge 0, no B/C sends. Rotate B t=600001: gauge stays 3, fake calls stay 1, then exactly 1 B mail whose token hash equals the new stored digest and differs from the old digest read through a second SQLite connection. Without cleanup, resolve A at t=86400001: B expires exactly at its boundary and is never sent; C expires at 86400002 and sends. These operations must not wait for, resolve or advance A.

0 failing tests for D19 retry and in-flight cancellation: reject A attempt 1 temporarily and hold its retry sleep; unsubscribe A aborts that sleep, drops its waiting job data and immediately leaves gauge 2, no A attempt 2, B is next. Unsubscribe A while A attempt 1 is unresolved answers 200 without aborting its send signal; once resolved A makes no further attempt and its actual result is counted as usual. Timeout settings 120000 and default give the fake literal timeoutMs 60000 and 5000. Unsubscribe, cleanup and subscribe steps 1 (expired row) and 4 (rotation) synchronously cancel waiting jobs AFTER the database commit and BEFORE answering/returning; no old job/address/token reference remains behind an unrelated blocked send. Independent HMAC construction uses a second connection's row id and the test key, not the token builder under test.

exit 0; lint, typecheck, all tests and full coverage remain green. New metrics register only when explicitly enabled; feature-off metrics and existing channel behavior remain unchanged. README/configuration/operation/email docs describe invariant accepted replies, bounds/cooldown/window/queue, token lifecycle, double opt-in configured-origin mail and D19 immediate queue cancellation, expiry and the at-most-60-second in-flight boundary. Production entry point still has no subscription listener until T4.

tasks.title: Fan out public manual events with durable retry and recovery budgets
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, complete R5 Detection/Fan-out worker 2 including durable pass algorithm and recovery, R7 detection/mail/pending metrics, D3-D6/D11-D12, id-only paging and bounded address retention and Eligibility and privacy/Fan-out failures counterexamples. Implements the whole detection and retry algorithm in one task; poll/startup integration is T4. Acceptance evidence item 1 and prior plan-review durable-budget defect.

acceptance.expected: 0 failing tests; focused coverage gate is not an exit-0 assertion. Fresh public manual baseline seeds three visible incidents quietly with 0 sends; next update gives 1 per confirmed row. Pending gets 0 incident messages while confirmed gets 3 for opened/update/resolved; confirmed_at=detected_at is eligible, confirmed_at=detected_at+1 is not. History is not replayed. Public projections only: drafts/private notes/internal incidents and leaked explicit private flags give 0 events/sends, later publication gives exactly 1 per eligible address, repeated content keys do not resend. No automatic incidents/reminders/warnings; reuses existing detector and notification projection, never ledger or /admin.

0 failing tests for one-event-at-a-time ordering by detected_at then key, 250 confirmed rows read in 3 pages of at most 100 IDS ONLY with 250 unique sends, and independent workers. Hold the first send unresolved, unsubscribe row 2 in id order, then resolve: row 2 gets 0 sends, because each address/state is read by id immediately before its send with no await between read and send. Worker 2 holds at most its current send's one address. Unsubscribe before retry prevents further sends even across restart; an already-started send may finish but times out within min(PULSE_NOTIFY_TIMEOUT_MS, 60000). 550/refused recipient fails after 1 attempt without blocking other rows; temporary error leaves recipient for next pass. To/envelope contains only own address, bodies use exact cleaned public fields, no reason/check/component/other address, stable per-event/id Message-ID, unsubscribe link always present.

0 failing tests for every Pass budget across restarts row with a real stop and NEW worker and store connection. For N=3: durable passes=2 survives stop before pass 3, exactly 3 total attempts and failed attempts=3, done E1, no fourth attempt, E2 starts. Restart after committed pass=3 while send awaits abort finalizes E1 with 0 recovery sends and starts E2 before any sleep. Stored next_pass_at=T+400 with restart T+100 asks for exactly 300 ms. Ten immediate restarts still allow at most 3 pass starts. RETRY_ATTEMPTS=0 uses 12 finite passes then advances. Restart of done event gives 0 sends. Pass increments commit before first send; terminal records and next_pass_at survive reopen; aborted send writes no delivery.

0 failing tests: committed seed/empty/new detections increment pulse_notify_subscriber_detections_total exactly 1 only after rows are visible on a second SQLite connection; errors/404 increment 0. Pending-events gauge stays nonzero through sends and retry sleeps and becomes 0 only after settlement; incident success/failure counted before event leaves pending. These invariants support deploy S1-S5 barriers and never use pollDone as detection evidence.

exit 0; lint, typecheck, complete tests and 80% coverage pass, including lifecycle/enumeration suites and unchanged channel/ledger tests. README/email docs state manual-only future-event delivery, first-enable seeding, at-least-once stable IDs, 100-id paging with one address at a time, finite durable retry/recovery semantics and unsubscribe race rule.

tasks.title: Run subscription workers and deletion commands safely in production and provide full evidence
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, production wiring and all remaining checks/completion evidence. Integrate R3-R5 components: validated settings before I/O, own lease/heartbeat, startup cleanup and independent hourly timer including D19 cancellation, listener before notifier, good manual reads/listedIds after channel processing, workers and shutdown; R5 CLI executable dispatch; R7 optional metrics; R8-R10; D12 capped sends and D14 SMTP password-file login; Docker host ENV; Security impact, Performance impact, Rollout order and all Acceptance evidence notify obligations including items 8-9. Final checks cover the whole change without changing channel ledger/config format or #570 reports.

acceptance.command: bun test test/subscriptions-settings.test.ts test/subscribers-cli.test.ts test/subscriptions-fanout.test.ts test/subscriptions-security.test.ts test/index.test.ts test/metrics.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 failing tests; focused coverage is not the gate. Real executable/production wiring rejects each missing/invalid required variable with exit 2 naming only variable; root-prefix refusal before any files/listeners; off opens no store/lock/worker/listener or metrics even with unwritable state directory. Separate store lease/heartbeat loss and bind/start failures unwind resources. Startup cleanup precedes listener, independent hourly cleanup deletes within 25 hours even when API polls fail and synchronously cancels deleted rows' queued confirmations behind a held send; listener starts before notifier. Test actual production wiring of D19 cancellation and the D12 timeout cap, with missing/invalid SMTP login/password settings refused and a valid password passed to SMTP without logging it. Good non-404 manual reads and listedIds reach detection after channels; errors/404 do not seed/prune/increment detection. Stop closes listener, aborts workers/sleeps and cleanup timer, checkpoints/closes store and releases both locks; shutdown cannot reset durable retry budget.

With subscriptions off/no SMTP config, delete Sub-A@Example.com gives exactly 'deleted 1' then 'deleted 0', exit 0, no address in output; active service lock gives exit 2 unchanged; invalid address and wrong arity give exact fixed lines and exit 1; missing database creates no store. Second connection shows neither subscriber nor delivery rows and WAL size 0 after deletion.

0 failing tests; full flow with failing SMTP captures logs/metrics and all listener route/status answers and finds 0 subscriber addresses, confirmation/unsubscribe tokens, bearer/key/password values. Store and lock mode 0600. Each mail has exactly 1 To and no CR/LF Subject; only public incident fields used. Applicable Security impact checklist: auth-before-body, 1024-byte request cap, bounded rows/pending/window/100-job FIFO/id-only paging, strict normalized inputs/token patterns/timing-safe comparisons, hashed confirmation storage, secure deletion/checkpoints, immediate queued-job cancellation/expiry behind blocked sends and at-most-60-second in-flight retention, fixed configured-origin links, no redirects/secrets in errors, password-file startup errors without content, full-SHA pins and no new package. The R7 hidden-field exception exists only in status, never in notify JSON.

All notify section and counterexample checks pass, including both-order membership comparisons, 0 unconfirmed sends versus 3 confirmed, 0 post-unsubscribe versus 1 other recipient, private fixtures 0 and published draft 1, retry restart counts, and detection/confirmation/pending metric ordering. Recheck the corrected MAX=5/MAX_PENDING=5 e2e configuration and both invalid pending-cap cases through the startup path, and the SMTP username/password/TLS rules of acceptance item 9.
